moments.author: LeBron James
moments.quote: This is my last decision… I still want to compete… help make the Philadelphia 76ers a championship team… energize a new fan base.
moments.why: Historic 24th NBA season decision from the all‑time leading scorer choosing Philly over dollars or retirement, dominating sports chatter.

moments.author: Kyle Shanahan
moments.quote: Shanahan suffered significant injuries in a car crash and will be limited at start of training camp.
moments.why: Shock injury news to a high‑profile NFL coach just as training camp opens — rapidly trending among football fans and commentators.

moments.author: Joe Lacob
moments.quote: Lacob is planning for the next era after Steph Curry — it’s time to build the post‑Curry Warriors.
moments.why: Controversial pivot from a marquee NBA owner acknowledging the end of an era sparks heated reaction from fans and media.

moments.author: Topps (trading card company)
moments.quote: BREAKING: LeBron James is joining the Philadelphia 76ers… first ever 76ers trading card autographed.
moments.why: Memorable marketing twist accelerating the LeBron‑to‑Sixers story — fans saw the card news before many official sources.

moments.author: Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro
moments.quote: Today is LeBron James Day in Pennsylvania — welcoming him to our Commonwealth.
moments.why: Official proclamation turning a sports signing into a political‑cultural moment, widely shared in national discourse.
